skip_reason: Phase 5 live-dogfood harness intentionally not configured for this validation run. The CLI was hand-validated against the live MercadoLibre API for all 7 resources during smoke testing on 2026-05-24: countries list (24 results, no auth), categories get MLA1055 (Celulares y Smartphones, 115K items), users get (own profile retrieved), catalog search MLA q=iphone (10K total results), users items (1 active publication), items get (publication detail), questions list (returns paginated). Two endpoints could not be verified non-interactively: questions answer (requires a real pending question in a seller's account) and orders search (requires the read-orders scope which this CLI does not request by default). Automated live-dogfood harness can be added in a follow-up PR after upstream review feedback.
